data.one_liner: A fully customizable rating bar and indicator widget supporting fractions and vertical layout.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable rating bars and indicators that allow users to select ratings or display existing ones. It supports fractional ratings, vertical layouts, custom item widgets, and RTL mode.
use_when: You need to display product or content ratings to users.
You need an interactive star or custom icon rating input in forms.
avoid_when: You need complex non-rating input form elements like sliders or date pickers.
strengths: Supports any custom widget for rating items and different items per position.
Supports fractional ratings and vertical or horizontal orientations.
Includes a rating bar indicator for read-only displays.
